finding: Recovery could clear pending using stale provider.dat after saving the new provider state failed
root_cause: Canonical file existence was treated as proof that the current failed invocation had durably synchronized its provider state

fix.journal: private provider-sync.json, written atomically with file and directory fsync
fix.before_freshclam: write pending synchronization with the exact staging ID before executing the updater
fix.after_freshclam: on success or error, save provider state, fsync it, compare its hash with the staging source, then durably record synced plus the hash
fix.recovery_pending_sync: re-save from the exact protected staging source; failure leaves attempt.pending=true
fix.recovery_synced: check canonical bytes against the recorded hash before allowing recovery
fix.missing_source: never accept an old canonical file when the pending source is missing
fix.no_provider_data: explicit synced null hash only when both source and canonical are absent; not conflated with stale canonical data
fix.revision: include synchronization evidence in the recovery revision
fix.legacy: without per-invocation evidence, re-save a single unambiguous source; canonical existence alone and multiple ambiguous sources cannot clear pending
fix.deadline_changes: none; persisted deadlines and owner extension rules remain enforced
fix.definition_generation_changes: none; synchronization concerns provider wait state only
fix.mcp_changes: none; updater and maintenance remain owner CLI only

cases: previous synced old canonical, new failed attempt and pre-save persistence failure: recovery blocked while persistence still fails; retry durably saves the new bytes before clearing pending
provider file replacement followed by durability failure: observable new bytes alone do not permit recovery; retry must complete synchronization
missing pending source and confirmed-hash mismatch: recovery refused and pending retained
legacy canonical alone refused; single unambiguous legacy staging source can be re-saved safely
new_regressions.red_green: the original persistence-failure test failed before the implementation because recovery did not raise; it passed after the fix
new_regressions.mutation: removing the pre-invocation pending marker caused the stale-previous-sync regression to fail as expected
new_regressions.fault_injection: private synthetic stores, fake updater failure and controlled persistence errors; no real provider traffic or cooldown override

verification.windows: 17 native Windows API tests skipped on macOS; no Windows CI or real Windows acceptance

npm.includes: packed distribution, initial setup and stdio MCP round trip

remaining: native recovery acceptance using the new synchronization journal after real freshclam failure and storage recovery
legacy stores with missing or ambiguous synchronization sources require owner investigation rather than forced recovery
Linux/Windows native acceptance and Windows CI
different official definition-version update after natural expiry and native resume invalidation
